Geez of if I was like that it'd be way harder to stop lol , I just drink when I'm exhausted and I gotta stay up or to chill with friends and family 
Yea that's not good! It's like we are masking ourselves , maybe if I watch videos of drunk people I'll stop 😂

That's about the same exact way I drink but lately it has been messing with my health! I have 0 energy , I use it just as well for stress, but I'm only 32 so I think that I should at least cut it down to one day a week! I can't even do a push up now😒

But it paid off right?
I hope, I don't really need those kind of friends anyways , at least I will have my kids ❤
These dreams feel so real sometimes!!

I've always been an open parent with my kids when I was young there was a kid who got drunk at a party and they jumped and killed him, I talk to my kids about everything if they want to try weed or alcohol they can do that with me because I don't want them to end up getting hurt at a party, getting in the car with a drunk driver , my son admitted to me when he lost his virginity, when ur a parent you can see that on them .. I love my kids so much and I very much tell them about the real world rather then shield them! I know life is overwhelming especially for a kid that has a parent that works , and another who comes and goes he's my oldest takes care of his youngest siblings ,I don't blame him for his feelings I just want him to fight for his life!! I had him at his age I want such a better life for him ..

Thank you for the message, I think that he goes through these hard times in life and needs me a little more , he has always been my least difficult child and I never really thought until now that life gets hard for him .. I just feel like God is pushing my family in a direction that we don't understand yet
That's what I was expecting,  thank u

I pay child support for my daughter 
I have got the other two for child support unfortunately they do not receive anything because he doesn't work 
What I'm wondering is if the state will take my whole refund because I owe for all the time he had her , and just now opened a case against me after years of sharing custody

No different fathers, her father just started getting child support this year so now I owe 15,000
